# Olam H3 API / Media Coverage Matrix

| User/runtime action | Browser / domain path | Server / provider path | Existing proof | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Read provider readiness | `MinimaxProxyClient.status()` | `GET /api/olam-h3/status` → `ChesedH3Handlers.status()` | proxy client test + live HTTP 200 | Proven |
| Submit generation | `GenerationQueue.submit()` → `GenerationTransport.build()` → `proxy.create()` | `POST /api/olam-h3/create` → body → validator → mapper → `POST https://api.minimax.io/v2/video_generation` | proxy, server-contract, provider-transport tests | Proven |
| Poll task | scheduler → `GenerationQueue.poll()` → `proxy.task(taskId)` | `POST /api/olam-h3/task` → encoded upstream `GET /v2/query/video_generation/{task}` | proxy/provider tests | Proven |
| Persist task result | `GenerationRecord.fromTask()` → repository/cache policy | task `content.url`, usage, status | deterministic generation tests | Proven |
| Add local media | Create asset event → controller → `AssetService.addFile()` | local repository only until submission | deterministic asset validation/replacement suite | Proven components |
| Replace reusable media | Replace button → `CreateAssetEvents` carries `replaceId` → controller → `AssetService.replaceFile()` | stable repository ID receives new Blob/signature/metadata/updatedAt | service replacement test | Proven components |
| Refresh replaced preview | assigned view → `AssetPreviewCache.urlFor()` | revokes old object URL and creates URL for new Blob | preview-cache test | Proven |
| Serialize replaced local bytes | `GenerationTransport` resolves stable ID at submit time → `AssetService.toTransport()` | new data URL reaches create envelope | replacement transport test | Proven components |
| First frame | stable asset ID → transport role `first_frame` | mapper image content, adaptive ratio | server/combination tests | Proven |
| Last frame | stable asset ID → transport role `last_frame` | mapper image content, adaptive ratio | server/combination tests | Proven |
| Reference image/video/audio | stable IDs → role-specific transport arrays | ordered MiniMax content roles | server/combination tests | Proven |
| Invalid media combination | draft transport → server validator | rejected before paid upstream call | combination tests | Proven |
| Missing provider secret | queue/proxy → server client | server throws 503 before `fetch` | provider transport + live status | Proven |
| Upstream network/error | proxy/client | network→502, upstream status/message preserved | provider/proxy tests | Proven |
| Visible Replace gesture all the way to fresh outgoing bytes | real Replace UI event → controller → repository → refreshed preview → transport | create-ready payload must contain replacement bytes exactly once | no single existing test spans the whole chain | **Missing** |

## Live-production evidence
Current production/current-main lineage was verified at `57e4dd4b096118f57c98a61acad42cb8106a3699` during this pass. Better V2 is an ancestor with zero delta in its eight release paths. Current production passed all five public Chrome suites plus HTTP 200 for the app, status route, and four Better V2 style modules.

## External-only boundary
Production reports MiniMax-H3 `configured:false`. Real paid upstream generation cannot be truthfully executed until the external production credential is configured. All non-paid route, validation, mapping, proxy, replacement, cache, and live UI paths are independently testable now.

NEXT_ACTION: add one focused integration test spanning the actual Replace UI/controller path through stable repository identity, preview invalidation, and GenerationTransport fresh-byte serialization.
